release: Shorts-LM large discovery seed catalogue v0.2

youtube.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 compilation; underlying content rights remain separate
youtube.sampling: evenly spaced pages across source row index; not a probability sample

instagram.selection: rank-ordered latest account snapshot; person and org types retained separately

limitations: Not 10,000 verified humans per platform; records are account-level leads.
YouTube entity type is unknown; current Shorts activity must be checked.
Instagram person and organization counts are kept separate; no organization is relabelled as a person.
Cross-platform identities are not merged without explicit evidence.
No row grants retrieval, storage, analysis, derived-artifact retention or model-training rights.
Generated hashtags are not proof of native usage, popularity or retrieval yield.
